tools.name: spendguard_evaluate
tools.description: Free. Check a proposed Base USDC payment against a spending policy you supply (per-transaction limit, daily budget, human-approval threshold, allowed recipients) before money moves. Returns APPROVE, HUMAN_APPROVAL or BLOCK with findings. Advisory only: it never signs, holds keys or moves funds.

tools.name: quick_check
tools.description: Fast pre-payment sanity check for agents on Base: confirms the RPC reports Base mainnet (chain ID 8453) and that the official USDC contract has deployed code. No request body. Returns PASS or FAIL with both checks and a timestamp. It is not a token-risk report, transaction simulation or payment proo

tools.name: token_risk
tools.description: Token-risk report for one Base ERC-20 contract. Checks whether the token can be sold (honeypot simulation), buy/sell/transfer tax, owner privileges (mint, pause, blacklist, balance changes, proxy upgrades), holder concentration and DEX liquidity. Returns ALLOW, WARN, BLOCK or INCOMPLETE with scored

tools.name: preflight
tools.description: Simulate one unsigned Base transaction before an agent signs it. Runs eth_call and gas estimation on current chain state, decodes the intent (ERC-20 transfer, approve, NFT setApprovalForAll), flags unlimited approvals, calldata sent to a non-contract, zero-address targets, reverts and destination ri

tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Verify Base USDC payment by transaction hash: did my x402 payment settle? Check recipient and amount (and optional sender) against the official USDC Transfer logs before releasing goods or credit. Returns VERIFIED, MISMATCH, FAILED or PENDING_OR_NOT_FOUND with block, confirmations, the matching tran

tools.name: kushbitx_preflight
tools.description: One check before money moves on Base. Simulates the unsigned transaction, decodes approvals and transfers, screens the token and the recipient or spender, and applies a protected SpendGuard policy when given. Returns ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK with sourced findings. Fail-closed: no ALLOW unless every ch

tools.name: signature_check
tools.description: Check an EIP-712 signature request before an agent signs it: EIP-3009 (x402 payments), EIP-2612 Permit and Permit2. Checks the chain, the token domain, payTo and amount, the spender, unlimited amounts and long validity. Returns ALLOW, REVIEW or BLOCK bound to the EIP-712 digest. Unknown typed data i

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "verify_payment" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
